COMMERCIAL VEHICLES AND BUSES — 
GEARBOX FLANGES — TYPE S 



NATIONAL FOREWORD 

This Indian Standard, which is identical with ISO 7647 : 1986 'Commercial vehicles and buses — 
Gearbox flanges — Type S' was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on 22 February 1990 on 
the recommendation of the Automotive Transmission Systems Sectional Committee ( TED 3 ) and 
approval of the Transport Engineering Division Council. 

The text of ISO standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without 
deviations. Certain conventions are, however, not identical to those used in Indian Standards. 
Attention is particularly drawn to the following: 

a) Wherever the words International Standard' appear, referring to this standard, they should 
be read as 'Indian Standard'. 

b) Comma ( , ) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards, the current 
practice Is to use point ( . ) as the decimal marker.

1 Scope and field of application 

This International Standard specF^es the homlnal dimensions 
and tolerances which affect the interchangeabillty between 
gearbox flanges and mating parts used on commercial vehicles 
and buses. The flanges covered by this International Standard 
are designated type S. They are not interchangeable with 
type A flanges dealt with in ISO 7646. 

Dimensions not specified are left to the discretion of the com- 
ponent manufacturer. 



2 References 

ISO 286, fSO system of limits and fits. ^' 

ISO 1101, Technical drawings — Geometrical tolerancing — 
Tolerancing of form, orientation, location and rurhout — 
Generalities, definitions, symbols, indications on drawings. 

ISO 7646, Road vehicles — Gearbox flanges for commercial 
vehicles and buses — Type A. 



3 Dimensions and tolerances 

Nominal dimensions, tolerances and bolt hole fixing positions 
which affect the interchangeabillty of type S flanges for gear- 
boxes are shown in figures 1 to 3, and given in the table. 



4 Designation 

Gearbox flanges meeting the requirements of this International 
Standard shall be identified by the following details in the order 
specified : 

a) reference to this International Standard; 

b) the size code (see table); 

c) the number of fixing bolts; 

d) the size of the fixing bolts. 

Example: 

Designation of a gearbox flange type S with size code 1 500 
and four 14 mm fixing bolts: 

Range ISO 7647 - 1 500 x 4 x 14 



1) At present at the stage of draft. IRevision of ISO/R 286-1962.)

Bareaa of iBdIan standards 

BIS is a statutory institutiou established undeT the Bureau of Indian Standard Act^ 1986 to promote 
harmonious development of the activities of standardization, marking and quality certification of goods 
and attending to connected matters in the country. 

Copyright 

BIS has the copyright of all its publications. No part of these publications may be reproduced in 
any from without the prior permission in writing of BIS. This does not preclude the free use, in the 
course of implementing the standard, of necessary details, such as symbols and sizes, type of grade 
designations. Enqufaies relating to copyright be addressed to the Director (Publications), BIS. 

Revision of Indian Standards 

Indian Standards are reviewed periodically and revised, when necessary and amendments, if any, are 
issued from time to time. Users of Indian Standards should ascertain that they are in possession of 
the latest amendments or edition. Comments on this Indian Standard may be sent in BIS giving the 
following reference :
